# Spread with Arrays

#### Course: Modern JavaScript Essentials

## Spread with Arrays

The spread operator (...) expands an array into individual elements. It is one of the most versatile additions from ES6. You can use it to merge arrays or pass array elements as function arguments - all without mutating the original.

For example,

```javascript
1const frontend = ["HTML", "CSS", "JavaScript"]; 
2const backend = ["Node", "Express"];
3
4const fullStack = [...frontend, ...backend]; 
5console.log(fullStack);
```

Here, ...frontend unpacks each element from the first array, and ...backend does the same for the second. The result is a single flat array combining both.
